entities.name: AWS
entities.rationale: Green cloud-with-lock icon at top-left labeled 'AWS'. Represents the public cloud telemetry data sources (S3, SNS, SQS, CloudTrail, GuardDuty mentioned in transcript) feeding Apache Metron. Not inside any container.

entities.name: ON-PREM
entities.rationale: Grey computer icon at left labeled 'ON-PREM'. Represents on-premises data sources sending syslog/Kafka events to Apache Metron. Not inside any container.

entities.name: APACHE METRON
entities.rationale: Orange EC2 icon at top-center labeled 'APACHE METRON'. Heart of the next-gen SOC, doing parsing, enrichment and profiling. Drawn outside (above) the Security Data Lake dashed box.

entities.name: SOAR
entities.rationale: Orange EC2 icon at top-right labeled 'SOAR'. Security orchestration and response platform (Blitz) receiving alerts from Metron. Not inside any container.

entities.name: EMR
entities.rationale: Purple EMR icon labeled 'EMR', drawn INSIDE the yellow dashed box labeled 'Security Data Lake'. EMR job moves persistent HDFS data from Metron into S3.

entities.name: S3
entities.rationale: Green bucket icon labeled 'S3', drawn INSIDE the yellow dashed box labeled 'Security Data Lake'. Long-term storage of telemetry events.

entities.name: ATHENA
entities.rationale: Purple Athena icon labeled 'ATHENA', drawn INSIDE the yellow dashed box labeled 'Security Data Lake'. SQL queries and analytics over S3 data.

entities.name: ALERTS
entities.rationale: Grey users/group icon at right labeled 'ALERTS'. Represents SOC analysts receiving alerts from SOAR (mobile/Jira) and triggering response. Not inside any container.

entities.name: WAF
entities.rationale: Orange EC2-style icon at bottom-right labeled 'WAF'. Drawn with the EC2 compute icon rather than the AWS WAF icon; represents WAF/firewall/router integrations used to block sources. Not inside any container.

visual_connections.description: Pink horizontal arrow from the AWS icon to Apache Metron: cloud telemetry ingested (via Apache NiFi per transcript).
Pink curved arrow rising from ON-PREM up to Apache Metron: syslog/Kafka ingestion of on-prem events.
Pink horizontal arrow from Apache Metron to SOAR: alerts sent to the orchestration and response platform.
Pink curved arrow leaving the left side of Apache Metron and going down into EMR: persistent HDFS data picked up by an EMR job.
Short pink arrow down from EMR to S3: transformed data written to S3.
Pink arrow pointing left from S3 to Athena: Athena queries data in S3.
Pink curved arrow from the right edge of the Security Data Lake dashed box up to Apache Metron: feedback loop of long-term profiles/models into Metron.
Short pink arrow down from SOAR to ALERTS: enriched alerts presented to SOC analysts.
Short pink arrow down from ALERTS to WAF: analyst triggers mitigation such as blocking a source.
